    parcels.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
    
    # Initialize DP table
    dp = [0] * (n + 1)
    
    # Iterate over each parcel

        ini, outi, wi, si, vi = parcels[i - 1]
        
        # Try to deliver the current parcel
        dp[i] = dp[i - 1]
        
        # Check if we can put the current parcel on the platform

            # Try to find the last parcel that can be delivered before the current one
            j = i - 1

            # Update DP value if we can put the current parcel on the platform
            if j > 0:
                dp[i] = max(dp[i], dp[j - 1] + vi)
    
    return dp[n]
